lines.text: Previously. Forty Red Giants marched on Fort Cinder, in step, like soldiers.
I opened the door in the axe. Just a crack. Akuro looked out through my eyes.
lines.tts: I opened the door in the axe. Just a crack. Ah-koo-roh looked out through my eyes.

lines.text: Rin got hurt. I did that.
And the Guild executioner told me she always comes.
Run. Run, little ones. Do not look back.
The grey is in the trees.
The grey that walks like a man.
I am walking. I am not riding in that cart for one more hour.
The medic said ten days.
The medic said a lot of things. He also said Wick was a lamp.
He did! He tried to hang a pot over me!
Two days, Nemu. You called it.
lines.tts: Two days, Neh-moo. You called it.

lines.text: I always call it. I just never say it loud enough.
...Why is he walking so far behind?
He's been walking behind since the fort. Ten steps. Always ten.
Takuto! Walk with us!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh! Walk with us!

lines.text: I'm fine here.
You are ten steps away so you can swing the axe without hitting anybody. I know what you are doing.
...Eleven, then.
Idiot.
I'll walk with him. Ten steps behind is a good place for a nap anyway.
Nemu. Wait. Look at the road.
lines.tts: Neh-moo. Wait. Look at the road.

lines.text: Feathers? Big ones. Red and black.
Plume Ogres. The same feathers we found at Marrowmere.
Plume Ogres live deep in the Greatwood. They never come out to the roads.
Never is a word that keeps getting broken lately.
Can I tell you what dying feels like?
...You want to?
Nobody ever asks. So I want to.
First it is cold. Like falling into the river in winter. Then it is warm, like a blanket. Then nothing for a while.
Then you wake up, and you are very, very hungry. And everyone around you is crying.
That is why you sleep so much.
Sleeping is the warm part, without the cold part first. It is cheating.
...At the fort. You shouted my name. I heard it from very far away.
I am very loud when I want to be. I just almost never want to.
If you go red again, I will shout again. Every time. Even if you are a hundred steps behind.
And if I don't hear you?
Then I will bite you.
...Fair.
Hunters! On the road! Hunters!
Finally. Somebody fetch the elder.
Welcome, Hunters. I am Abel, elder of this ford. You came about the ogres?
Three raids in four nights. They take grain. Only grain. And they burned the mill.
Anyone hurt?
Old Merrick broke his leg running. And the Pell boy was knocked into the river. No one dead. Yet.
Yet!
Everybody keeps saying yet. I really hate yet.
Yet is just tomorrow being rude.
Plume Ogres eat meat. Why would they steal grain?
Because whatever they are running from does not let them hunt.
Running from what?
That's the question. And the village wants an answer with a sword in it.
Kill them, Hunters. Whatever the Guild charges. Before they come back.
We will stand watch tonight. And then we will see.
Real flour. Real wheat flour. Fresh eggs. Cabbage. Takuto. TAKUTO.
lines.tts: Real flour. Real wheat flour. Fresh eggs. Cabbage. Tah-koo-toh. TAKUTO.

lines.text: You can make it.
I can make it! Okonomiyaki! Proper! Almost proper! No sauce, but almost!
Will-o'-Wisp, very gently. Only the pan. Only the PAN.
And... flip!
It is a pancake with cabbage in it.
It is my mother's pancake with cabbage in it. Eat it with respect.
...Mm. Oh. Oh no. It's good.
It IS good. Wick. Why have you been feeding us burned rabbit for a month?
Because nobody gave me flour!
...It tastes like Osaka.
lines.tts: ...It tastes like Oh-sah-kah.

lines.text: You've never been to Osaka.
lines.tts: You've never been to Oh-sah-kah.

lines.text: It tastes like what I thought Osaka would taste like.
lines.tts: It tastes like what I thought Oh-sah-kah would taste like.

lines.text: ...That's the nicest thing anyone's said to me in three years. Shut up. Eat.
Takuto. Pass the salt.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Pass the salt.

lines.text: It's salt. Not my arm. You won't break it.
I'm sorry. About the fort. I keep thinking about it.
Stop. I heard you the first time. And the second. And the ninth. Say it again and I'll tie your mouth shut.
Can you do that?
Do you want to find out?
...Here is the salt.
Thank you.
OGRES! The granary! OGRES!
They are taking the sacks!
The barn is on fire!
That's the chieftain. The one with the mask. Takuto, careful.
lines.tts: That's the chieftain. The one with the mask. Tah-koo-toh, careful.

lines.text: A big one. Feathers and bone. Let me look, boy.
No.
Spear! Low!
Break!
He broke its spear!
One arm is enough for this! Red Thread!
Afterimage! Finish it, Takuto!
lines.tts: Afterimage! Finish it, Tah-koo-toh!

lines.text: Not you. Not fighting you.
Grain. For the little ones. Hungry. We run from the grey.
...It talked.
Fiends do not talk.
That one did.
Kill me, white one. Then they starve slower. Or let me go. Then they starve faster. You choose.
Well? It is asking you, boy. Break it, or do not. I am curious too.
Takuto!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh!

lines.text: Take one sack. Only one. And do not come back to this village.
White one. Remember. The grey is coming. For all of us.
You let it go. You had it on its knees, and you let it go!
Half the barn is ash!
What kind of Hunter lets a Fiend walk away?
The kind who heard it talk.
Fiends do not talk, boy!
Everyone keeps saying that. Like if they say it enough, it will be true.
...My brother died to a Fiend, Takuto.
lines.tts: ...My brother died to a Fiend, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: I know.
If that ogre had said please before it killed him, would that make it better?
No. But it didn't kill anyone here. It took grain. It was starving.
Rin. He's not wrong. And you're not wrong. That's the worst kind of problem.
Can I say something? Three years ago, a farmer chased me out of his barn with a pitchfork. Because my head was on fire.
He thought I was a Fiend. I was just cold and hungry. Like that ogre.
...What do you want to do, Takuto?
lines.tts: ...What do you want to do, Tah-koo-toh?

lines.text: Find their camp. Find out what the grey is. If they are being pushed, something is pushing them.
Static.
Static.
Fine. I'll stay and keep the village from hanging us. Nemu and Wick, go with him. Rin...
lines.tts: Fine. I'll stay and keep the village from hanging us. Neh-moo and Wick, go with him. Rin...

lines.text: I'm going too. Someone has to tie him down if he starts laughing.
This forest is very big and very quiet, and I would like to state for the record that I hate it.
Forests are quiet when something big is listening.
Why would you say that?! Why would you say that out loud?!
Takuto. Since the fort. Has it said anything?
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Since the fort. Has it said anything?

lines.text: Last night. During the fight. It said let me look.
And?
And I said no. And then it said it was curious what I would do. With the ogre.
...Thank you for telling me.
You made me promise.
I know. Thank you for keeping it. Most people don't.
Telling on me to the girl. That is low, boy. I am wounded.
It says it is wounded.
Good.
Where did your boy go, Hunter? To warn his friends?
Valen. My people want torches and the forest. Tonight.
Then your people will die in the forest tonight, Abel. With torches in their hands.
They burned our barn!
They took our grain!
They took grain. And they could have taken children. Four nights, three raids, and not one of you is dead. Think about that.
I have fought Fiends for twenty years. The ones that want you dead do not stop at the granary.
And if you are wrong?
Then I will stand at your gate myself, with both swords, and I will not move until it is morning.
Go home. Lock your doors. Let the boy do something nobody has tried before.
There are small ones. Look. Children.
There must be fifty of them. All hiding.
White one. You followed.
You said the grey is coming. I want to know what it is.
Wolves. A grey pack. Hundreds. Red eyes. They do not eat. They only chase.
They chase us from the deep wood. Out to the roads. Out to your farms. Out to your swords.
They are pushing you at the villages. On purpose.
At the head of the pack walks a wolf with a man's back. With a long blade. He laughs when we run.
And beside him, sometimes, a thing in a black skin. It crackles. Like lightning in a jar.
Static.
He is herding them. The giants. The Hydra. The ogres. All of them.
Herding them where?
West. Always west. Toward the golden city.
Saint Lumen.
Why can you talk? Everyone says Fiends can't talk.
Everyone says. Nobody asks. My grandmother's grandmother came from the Rift. We stayed. We learned. We are not all teeth, white one.
You. You have something in your axe that is all teeth. I can smell it.
Rude. Accurate, but rude.
I know. I keep the door shut.
Good. Keep it shut. The grey likes open doors.
Hey. Hey, little guys. Want to see a trick?
Three blue fireballs. Watch. Watch!
Ha ha ha!
They have not laughed since the grey came. Thank you, fire head.
Fire head. I like that. Nobody has ever called me that with respect.
Eyes. In the trees. So many eyes.
The grey! The grey is here! Little ones, RUN!
Get behind the fire! Only the wolves burn! Only the wolves!
Left! Three of them!
Break!
So many, boy. Hundreds. You will never stop them with one axe and two hands. Let me help.
Rin. It's talking. Now.
Then hold still. Red Thread. Wrist to wrist.
If you go red, I feel it. And I pull.
Then don't let go.
Behind the ogres! Nemu, the children!
lines.tts: Behind the ogres! Neh-moo, the children!

lines.text: Got them!
Fire head coming through! Little ones, behind me!
Two of the children ran the wrong way! Into the trees!
Go. I have the front.
Don't go red while I'm gone.
Takuto, they are trying to split us!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh, they are trying to split us!

lines.text: Let them try!
Got them! Both of them! One bit me!
White one! Together!
Together!
Ruinbreaker!
Ha. The little F-rank who talks to monsters.
Tell the Laughing Blade. Kurozane remembers Grey Hollow.
Was that... was that a wolf? Standing up? With a sword?
Kurozane. The Fang Ronin. There are posters for him in every Guild hall. Rank A bounty.
Grey Hollow. That is where Sieg lost his squad.
lines.tts: Grey Hollow. That is where Seeg lost his squad.

lines.text: ...You held on. The thread never pulled. Not once.
I could feel you on the other end. It was enough.
We go north. Away from the gold city. Away from the grey.
The village will give you grain for the road. Sieg paid for it. Wick paid too.
lines.tts: The village will give you grain for the road. Seeg paid for it. Wick paid too.

lines.text: All my reward money. Every coin. I am a broke Hunter now. Please clap.
I will clap later. I am tired.
Take this, white one. A feather from my mother. If you meet my people, show it. They will not fight you.
...Thank you.
And you, thread girl. You held him. I saw. That is a strong thread.
It is my brother's.
Then he is strong too. Still.
Do not go to the gold city, white one. The gold city is where the grey is going.
We are going to the gold city.
I know.
White one. Before we go. The thing in your axe. Do you know its name?
Akuro. The Crimson Calamity.
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh. The Crimson Calamity.

lines.text: My people have a song about the red one. The one who broke the sky.
Broke the sky?
Three hundred winters ago, there were no Rifts. Then the red one fought something in the clouds, and the sky cracked.
The cracks never healed. That is what the song says. Every Rift is a scar from that fight.
...Songs. Ogres and their songs. They always get the order of things wrong.
It says your song gets the order wrong.
Ha. Then ask it what the right order is. And listen carefully, when it lies.
Akuro. What did you fight in the sky?
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh. What did you fight in the sky?

lines.text: ...Something that wears a suit now. Go away, boy. I am tired.
Nemu. At the fort. You were the one who shouted.
lines.tts: Neh-moo. At the fort. You were the one who shouted.

lines.text: Mm.
I shouted too. He did not hear me. He heard you.
He did not hear you because you were flying. It is hard to hear someone who is flying.
...Is that a joke?
Half a joke. The other half is true. You were very high up.
Thank you. For bringing him back.
You are tying him down now. With your thread. That is better than shouting. Shouting is tiring.
Then we take turns.
Mm. Deal. You go first. I am going to sleep.
Sieg. There was a wolf in the forest. Standing on two legs. With a sword.
lines.tts: Seeg. There was a wolf in the forest. Standing on two legs. With a sword.

lines.text: He said to tell you. Kurozane remembers Grey Hollow.
...So he is still alive.
Who is he?
The night before Morvudd came, he walked into our camp. Behind the man in the black suit. He was the one who cut the alarm ropes.
I cut out his left eye. He took the last of my squad while I was doing it.
He wants you.
He always did. A duel. The Laughing Blade against the Fang Ronin. He thinks it is a song.
Is it?
...Ask me tomorrow, Takuto. Tonight I want to sit here and count the stars. All of them. Twice.
lines.tts: ...Ask me tomorrow, Tah-koo-toh. Tonight I want to sit here and count the stars. All of them. Twice.

lines.text: The ogres are gone north. No blood on our fields. I was wrong about you, boy.
I do not say that often. Do not make me say it twice.
Mister white hair! This is for you. My mum baked it. It is only a little burnt.
...Thank you.
Only a little burnt. That is the highest praise in this world. Trust me.
Can I have half?
You can have half.
Can I have the bigger half?
Come on. The pass is two days up the mountain. And then the capital.
You want me to kill the boy who talks to monsters?
No, no. Kill the teacher. The boy will follow him anywhere. Even into the ground.
Valen. Finally. I have waited six years for that laugh to stop.
Next time: the old shrine on the mountain pass.
Kurozane challenges Sieg to a duel. Sieg says yes.
lines.tts: Kurozane challenges Seeg to a duel. Seeg says yes.

lines.text: Afterimage against the wolf's blade. Six years of waiting, in one cut.
Episode eight. The Fang Ronin.
